comment_allowed_hosts: Extra Host header values this instance answers to, beyond loopback and bind_addr. Add the hostname of a reverse proxy / tunnel in front of CuliBox (host or host:port, no scheme, path or wildcard); any other Host header is refused.
comment_replies: Kill-switch for replying to a waiting session and answering its permission prompts Yes/No from the UI. Off unless true; read at boot, so a restart applies a change. Peek (last-message summary) works either way.
comment_shell: No shell agent is needed below: at boot CuliBox detects $SHELL and adds a profile for it (named after the shell, e.g. zsh) unless one of the agents already runs that binary. That profile is what the UI's +sh button spawns; define your own shell agent to override the detection.
comment_persistence: Sessions run under abduco so they survive a daemon restart. abduco must be installed (the daemon fails fast if not): CuliBox uses the abduco next to the culibox binary, else the one on PATH. Set abduco_bin only to force a specific binary; that turns the lookup next to culibox off. data_dir and abduco_socket_dir are optional: leave them out and everything lives in the data root ($CULIBOX_HOME, else ~/.local/share/culibox), which is also where this file belongs. Setting them pins a fixed path that CULIBOX_HOME does not change; setting data_dir also turns off the one-time move of the old ~/.local/share/agent-box root to ~/.local/share/culibox.
comment_transfer: File transfer caps. All optional; omitting one uses the default shown. There is deliberately no way to express 'unlimited': 0 or a negative number means 'use the default', so a typo cannot uncap the write path.
comment_containment: Sessions run contained ('box' tier) by default: a per-project Docker container with only that project directory mounted (no home, no ~/.ssh, no docker socket). 'host' is the uncontained tier, for work that genuinely needs the machine. default_runtime sets the tier for every agent that does not name its own, INCLUDING the auto-detected shell profile, which no per-agent setting can reach. Omitting it means box.
comment_extra_ca: PEM files of extra CA certificates (e.g. a corporate TLS-inspection root) that every box trusts on top of the image's own. Export only the root you need, not a whole system bundle. Empty = none. Read at daemon start.
comment_vm_folders: macOS only: the box VM shares only the folders listed in vm-shares.json in the data root, which CuliBox writes. It is not a config key. Manage it in Settings > VM folders or with: culibox box share list|add <dir> [-ro]|rm <dir>|apply.
comment_bundle: What a contained session may see of your agent configuration. Sourced by allowlist only: CLAUDE.md, skills/, agents/, commands/, plus a filtered settings.json and the MCP servers that can actually run inside the image. Credentials, history and transcripts are never copied. Empty = auto-detect ($CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, else ~/.claude); 'off' disables bundling.
comment_credentials: Add AWS connections, GitHub Apps and static tokens in Settings > Credentials (saved to credentials.json in the data root), then tick them on a profile. config.json entries are only needed for a token file, an env var, an MCP server or a private egress host. See docs/AWS.md, docs/GITHUB.md and docs/STATIC-TOKENS.md.
comment_workspace: default_cwd cannot be your home directory when anything runs contained: the workspace is a box's only writable mount, so a box there would mount your whole home. Point it at a projects directory.

options.comment: enum → --effort <value>. model and effort are pickable on every claude profile even unset (offer_unset defaults on for model, effort and effortLevel only)
options.label: Effort

agents.comment: default base=inherit (full env). options set defaults shown as toggles on the spawn form, overridable per session. Add "account": "<name>" once that agent account exists in Settings > Agent accounts (it holds the Claude token; culibox init creates one named claude-box).
agents.name: claude

agents.comment: opt-in lock-down: base=clean, no inherited secrets; the account supplies the Claude token. Create the claude-box account first (culibox init, or Settings > Agent accounts), or a spawn is refused with unknown account.
agents.name: claude-locked
